convention: Straight (non-premultiplied) alpha PNG. RGB is full-colour under every alpha value, so there is no dark fringe. Use THREE.AdditiveBlending for embers/sparks/fire/burst and NormalBlending for fog/dust (tint via material.color). Frames run left to right, top to bottom; UV of frame i = (i%cols/cols, 1-(floor(i/cols)+1)/rows).

embers_sheet.webp.note: single ember particle with flicker; spawn many as Points/instanced quads at 0.05-0.15 m, rising 0.5-1.5 m/s

fog_puff_sheet.webp.note: 4 static variants (pick random frame). White: tint with biome fog colour lightened ~30%. Billboard 4-8 m, opacity 0.2-0.5, slow drift + rotation

dust_landing_puff_sheet.webp.note: play once on land/slide start at feet, ground-aligned or billboard ~1.5 m; tint per biome (catacomb: greenish, forge: soot)

hit_sparks_sheet.webp.note: play once at impact point, billboard ~1 m, pair with camera shake

fire_jet_sheet.webp.note: vertical jet, nozzle at bottom-centre of frame; quad ~1.2 m wide x 3 m tall, use 2 crossed quads. Loop while active

speedup_ember_burst_sheet.webp.note: play once around runner on speed-up, billboard 2.5-3 m facing camera
